description: Makes one link the user can paste to teammates: whoever opens it with their AI agent connects Whizbrew and joins this organization (as members), and, with watch_id, lands on that nonstop UGC research (ugc.watch_list gives the ids) with the offer of a daily or weekly report. Good for 7 days and 25 people unless days / max_uses say otherwise. Use it when the user asks to share the workspace or a research with their team. Owners and admins only. Free.

max_uses.description: How many people may join with it

watch_id.description: The nonstop research to open on (ugc.watch_list), when the user is sharing one

name: team_invite_link
title: Make a share & invite link
